results.title: In Youth We Trust
results.overview: Puek, a boy from the slums, had no choice but to endure his circumstances, feeling that he could never have the same worth as others. He remained silent, accepting the bullying of others just to survive in society.

results.title: Across
results.overview: Young Ela, trapped by the pandemic lock-down, peers out her window, unveiling the hidden lives of her neighbours – especially that of a mysterious boy. As a silent crisis unfolds, Ela's imagination becomes her secret weapon and when he needs help, she tries to reach him despite the distance.

results.title: Sometimes I Think About Dying
results.overview: Fran likes to think about dying. It brings sensation to her quiet life. When she makes the new guy at work laugh, it leads to more: a date, a slice of pie, a conversation, a spark. The only thing standing in their way is Fran herself.

results.title: Sofia Was
results.overview: Sofia was forced to leave her home and is now homeless. The young woman spends her days wandering the alleys of the University of São Paulo campus, where she offers her services as a tattoo artist. One ethereal night, her wanderings mingle with memories of an unfulfilled love. Wrapped in a dark, melancholy atmosphere, the film contemplates the fragility of a youth left behind. In a story that transcends borders, the life of an impenetrable fictional Sofia is imbued with the experiences of the actress of the same name who plays her. As enigmatic as an oracle, the original Portuguese title evokes the impermanence and ambiguity that haunt Sofia. She is carried away by perpetual motion, her future forever unknown.

results.title: Wake Up
results.overview: A group of young activists set out to make an environmental statement by vandalizing a home superstore as it closes. But their plan goes terribly wrong when they become trapped inside and must face a deranged security guard with a gruesome passion for primitive hunting. As the night fills with violence and terror, the teenagers find themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

results.title: Colors of Evil: Red
results.overview: When a girl's body is found on a beach in Poland's Tricity, a prosecutor teams up with the victim's mother on an impassioned quest for the truth.

results.title: Sonata
results.overview: Korean-American sisters and classical musicians, Viv and Gia, must grapple with diverging ambitions amidst the strain of caring for their ailing mother.

results.title: One Fast Move
results.overview: A dishonorably discharged soldier seeks out his estranged father to help him pursue his dream of becoming a professional motorcycle racer. While training, he meets a small-town, aspiring singer and a motorcycle shop owner who begin to break down the walls his father's absence had built up.

results.title: The Weekend
results.overview: This gripping Nigerian thriller will keep you guessing until the very last moment with its unique take on the age-old question: what’s wrong with the in-laws? ​

results.title: House of Izabel
results.overview: In an isolated countryside house founded by an elite, surrounded by slavery memories, a crossdresser retreat is set up. Far from the Brazilian dictatorship of the 70’s, men dress themselves with a glamour and delirious reality. This forged freedom crumbles when the real world infiltrates the house. Crossing the thin line between lies and truths. A fatality is just a matter of time…

results.title: Hostile Takeover
results.overview: After a meeting where The Unity Group is taking over the company, employees are asked to attend HR Training for new Corporate Orientation. At work, Emma starts to notice that something strange is happening to her colleagues after training.

results.title: Estado Febril
results.overview: Visual album of Bruna Alimonda's debut, "Estado Febril".

results.title: Cellar Door
results.overview: Looking for a fresh start after a miscarriage, a couple find themselves being gifted the house of their dreams with one caveat – they can never open the cellar door. Whether they can live without knowing triggers shocking consequences.

results.title: Cheaters
results.overview: Hot and sexy Angeline Aril star in this story that will titillate your imagination about two strangers who has a strong sexual connection only to find out that they’re both in a relationship. How can they sustain a relationship that started with sex and cheating?

results.title: Kid Snow
results.overview: A washed-up Irish boxer named Kid Snow is finally faced with a chance to redeem himself when he is offered a rematch against the man he fought a decade prior, on a night that changed his life forever. When he meets single mother Sunny, he is forced to contemplate a future beyond boxing.

results.title: Depravity
results.overview: A group of residents begins to suspect that their strange neighbor might be hiding something dark.

results.title: Just Sally
results.overview: In a black and white world, an evil headmaster attempts to expunge the color of her students, but one valiant girl pushes back.

results.title: Cloud
results.overview: Ryōsuke Yoshii, an ordinary reseller, carelessly earns grudges by people and becomes entangled in a life-threatening struggle.

results.title: Ernest Cole: Lost and Found
results.overview: More than 60,000 of Ernest Cole's 35mm film negatives were inexplicably discovered in a bank vault in Stockholm, Sweden. Most considered these forever lost, especially the thousands of pictures he shot in the U.S. Told through Cole's own writings, the stories of those closest to him, and the lens of his uncompromising work, the film is a reintroduction of a pivotal Black artist to a new generation and will unravel the mystery of his missing negatives.

results.title: Cunk on Life
results.overview: Pioneering documentary maker Philomena Cunk returns with her most ambitious quest to date: venturing right up the universe and everything to examine life and existence in an attempt to find out the point of it all. Along the way, she interrogates experts on subjects from the big bang to biology and art to artificial intelligence. Really get to the nub of it.
